Definition: Churam, the name of an Israelite and two Syrians
BiblicalUsage: Huram = "noble born"; 1) son of Bela and grandson of Benjamin; 2) king of Tyre allied with David and Solomon; alternate spelling for 'Hiram'; 3) a chief architect of Solomon's temple; alternate spelling for 'Hiram'
